title: U9-CHT canonical translation record (one JSONL line)
description: Canonical records identify the original text by resource, entry ID, exact source SHA-256 and unit count. They never contain the original English text or FLX layout details. Enforced by u9cht/l10n/store.py, which additionally requires the deterministic serialization (fixed field order, sorted by resource then entry_id, UTF-8, LF).

key.description: resource:entry_id; must agree with resource and entry_id

status.description: showcase-draft is accepted only for migrated P6-S/P6-S2 work and ranks as draft

context.description: short non-substantial context; never a source-text copy

terms.description: sorted glossary source terms this record is expected to render (exact tagged terms)

target.description: Traditional Chinese target. Authored line breaks are explicit \n (books: \r\n). Empty only when untranslated.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact source unit (text.flx: UTF-16LE text without terminator; TYPENAME: ASCII label; BOOKS: raw body bytes)

source_units.description: text.flx: UTF-16 code units; TYPENAME: ASCII bytes; BOOKS: body bytes

runtime_supported.description: false keeps the record out of runtime builds; null defers to resource-capabilities.json

runtime_evidence.description: sorted references to recorded runtime observations (phase:kind)

migrated_from.description: frozen showcase snapshot this record was migrated from
